newsitem.title: LATVIA: MANGALI FIRST QUARTER LOSS 41,529 LATS.
newsitem.headline: MANGALI FIRST QUARTER LOSS 41,529 LATS.

text.p: Mangali Shiprepair made a first quarter loss of 41,529 lats on turnover of 186,535 lats, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that the company's production expenses came to 203,343 lats, leading to a gross loss of 16,808 lats. The first quarter loss came after a 1996 total year loss of 12,019 lats.
In the first quarter, the company had administrative expenses of 44,934 lats and other operational income of 21,685 lats. Its pre-tax loss was 37,736 lats.
The company's assets after the first quarter were 1.78 million lats.
